name: Bases Row Deltas
changes: A Row deltas view with Pro options now shows free users a notice with a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Group the base by a property, such as a meter, so that each group starts its own comparison.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Row Deltas is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
